subject: [PATCH 5/8] selftests/mm: check that MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT preserve shared memory

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to verify that the MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT hints preserve shared memory, including dirty shared file pages, shared anonymous pages, and SHM_LOCK'd segments. The test checks that these hints do not cause the pages to be evicted or written back, but instead leave them resident. The test requires root privileges to confirm through /proc/kpageflags that a SHM_LOCK'd page is unevictable. The patch adds new functions to map shared memory and page out ranges until they are no longer mapped, and modifies existing functions to pin tasks to specific CPUs and drain LRU batches.
